text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收看《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收看《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實的對話

text: to help you understand.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can watch a video of this podcast
zh: 你可以观看这期播客的视频
zh_hant: 你可以觀看這期播客的影片

text: and find a worksheet
to help you learn on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 帮助你在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上学习。
zh_hant: 幫助你在我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com上學習。

text: Hi Beth, how are you today?
zh: 贝丝,你好,你今天怎么样?
zh_hant: 貝絲,你好,你今天怎麼樣?

text: I'm very good, Neil.
How are you?
I'm very well.
What are we talking about?
Today we are talking about work and the office .
zh: 今天我们谈论工作和办公室。
zh_hant: 今天我們談論工作和辦公室。

text: An office is a place with desks and computers
zh: 办公室是有桌子和电脑的地方
zh_hant: 辦公室是有桌子和電腦的地方

text: where people do their jobs.
OK.
We are in a studio in the office ,
zh: 我们在办公室的一个工作室里。
zh_hant: 我們在辦公室的一個工作室裡。

text: but we'll go back to the office after this.
zh: 不过这之后我们要回办公室。
zh_hant: 不過這之後我們要回辦公室。

text: Yes we will.
So, Neil, where do you work?
Do you work at home or do you work in the office ?
zh: 你是在家工作还是在办公室工作?
zh_hant: 你是在家工作還是在辦公室工作?

text: Well, I do both of those things.
I work in the office
usually three days a week,
and I work from home two days a week.
OK, I'm the same.
We have the same schedule.
So, yeah, at home twice,
where I have, a sort of place
zh: 我有一个属于自己的地方
zh_hant: 我有一個屬於自己的地方

text: that could be considered a home office .
zh: 那可以算作家庭办公室。
zh_hant: 那可以算作家庭辦公室。

text: Do you like working in the office ?
zh: 你喜欢在办公室工作吗?
zh_hant: 你喜歡在辦公室工作嗎?

text: I do like working in the office .
zh: 我确实喜欢在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 我確實喜歡在辦公室工作。

text: I think it's easy to get work done
zh: 我觉得完成工作很容易
zh_hant: 我覺得完成工作很容易

text: in the office because it's an office environment.
zh: 因为这是办公室环境,所以在办公室里。
zh_hant: 因為這是辦公室環境,所以在辦公室裡。

text: It's a workplace.
But I also quite like working from home sometimes
zh: 不过有时候我也挺喜欢在家工作的
zh_hant: 不過有時候我也挺喜歡在家工作的

text: because, commuting.
London is a big city, you know,
zh: 你知道,伦敦是一座大城市。
zh_hant: 你知道,倫敦是一座大城市。

text: coming to work and going back is really tiring if you do it
zh: 如果你天天上下班,真的挺累的。
zh_hant: 如果你天天上下班,真的挺累的。

text: every day.
Yeah, I know what you mean.
I like working from home
occasionally,
but I definitely prefer being in the office .
zh: 不过我还是更喜欢在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 不過我還是更喜歡在辦公室工作。

text: I think being with colleagues around you
zh: 我觉得和身边的同事在一起
zh_hant: 我覺得和身邊的同事在一起

text: and I need people,
and then I can work better.
zh: 这样我就能工作得更好。
zh_hant: 這樣我就能工作得更好。

text: Yeah.
So what's wrong with working from home ?
zh: 在家工作有什么不好的?
zh_hant: 在家工作有什麼不好的?

text: A lot!
I think,
when you're in the office , yeah, it's louder than at home,
zh: 在办公室的时候,是的,比在家里吵多了
zh_hant: 在辦公室的時候,是的,比在家裡吵多了

text: but I like having the people around me.
zh: 但我喜欢身边有人陪伴。
zh_hant: 但我喜歡身邊有人陪伴。

text: I like being able to have conversations.
I find it's easier to work
zh: 我发现这样更容易工作
zh_hant: 我發現這樣更容易工作

text: in an office environment
because everyone else is working.
But I feel more lonely at home because it's just me.
zh: 因为家里只有我一个人,所以我在家反而感觉更孤独。
zh_hant: 因為家裡只有我一個人,所以我在家反而感覺更孤獨。

text: So, yeah.
I understand what you mean.
I also have a bit of a problem
with working from home ,
because the boundary or the line
between work and home
is not so clear.
So when you finish your day,
you close your computer and you think,
oh, hang on, I'm still at home.
This is where I've been working all day.
zh: 这就是我一整天都在这里工作的地方。
zh_hant: 這就是我一整天都在這裡工作的地方。

text: And sometimes you feel like you should be doing things
zh: 有时候你会觉得自己应该做点什么
zh_hant: 有時候你會覺得自己應該做點什麼

text: for home when you're actually working.
zh: 当你实际在工作时,就待在家里。
zh_hant: 當你實際在工作時,就待在家裡。

text: Yeah, it's a bit weirder .
Like, it's, it's strange being at home
zh: 说真的,待在家里感觉怪怪的
zh_hant: 說真的,待在家裡感覺怪怪的

text: because it's harder to know
whether you should be working or doing a bit of housework.
zh: 你是应该工作还是做点家务。
zh_hant: 你是應該工作還是做點家務。

text: In the office ,
it's easier to just sit and be with your laptop,
zh: 直接坐着守着笔记本电脑更容易。
zh_hant: 直接坐著守著膝上型電腦更容易。

text: be with your colleagues and just be, be working.
zh: 和同事们在一起,就那样待着,做着工作。
zh_hant: 和同事們在一起,就那樣待著,做著工作。

text: Have you ever worked somewhere that is not an office ?
zh: 你有没有在非办公室的地方工作过?
zh_hant: 你有沒有在非辦公室的地方工作過?

text: Yes.
So I used to work at a farm.
zh: 我以前在一个农场工作过。
zh_hant: 我以前在一個農場工作過。

text: It was a farm park.
So lots of children playing and there was a cafe.
zh: 那里有很多孩子在玩耍,还有一家咖啡馆。
zh_hant: 那裡有很多孩子在玩耍,還有一家咖啡館。

text: There was a play area, go carts, being with animals.
zh: 有一个游乐区,有卡丁车,还可以和动物们在一起。
zh_hant: 有一個遊樂區,有卡丁車,還可以和動物們在一起。

text: So lots of different areas.
And it was fun.
Lots of variety.
So that wasn't an office .
What about you?
I've worked in all kinds of places, especially
zh: 我在各种各样的地方工作过,尤其是
zh_hant: 我在各種各樣的地方工作過,尤其是

text: when I was a student.
I worked in factories, farms.
I've worked in restaurants,
bars, all kinds of places that are not offices .
zh: 酒吧,以及各种不是办公室的场所。
zh_hant: 酒吧,以及各種不是辦公室的場所。

text: You've done it all.
I've done it all.
Let's recap some of the vocabulary we heard in this podcast.
zh: 我们来复习一下这期播客中听到的一些词汇。
zh_hant: 我們來複習一下這期播客中聽到的一些詞彙。

text: We had office , a place with desks and computers
zh: 我们有办公室,一个有桌子和电脑的地方。
zh_hant: 我們有辦公室,一個有桌子和電腦的地方。

text: where people go to work sometimes.
zh: 人们有时去工作的地方
zh_hant: 人們有時去工作的地方

text: At BBC Learning English, we work in the office.
zh: 在BBC英语教学,我们在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 在BBC英語教學,我們在辦公室工作。

text: We had working remotely ,
which we often also call working from home ,
zh: 我们也经常称之为在家办公,
zh_hant: 我們也經常稱之為在家辦公,

text: and that means working somewhere
zh: 这意味着要在某个地方工作
zh_hant: 這意味著要在某個地方工作

text: that isn't the office, for example, your home.
zh: 比如不是办公室的地方,像你家。
zh_hant: 比如不是辦公室的地方,像你家。

text: But it could also be a cafe or something.
zh: 不过也可能是咖啡馆之类的地方。
zh_hant: 不過也可能是咖啡館之類的地方。

text: And we also had colleagues .
These are the people that you work with.
zh: 这些就是和你一起工作的人。
zh_hant: 這些就是和你一起工作的人。

text: And we compared working from home
zh: 我们比较了在家办公的情况
zh_hant: 我們比較了在家辦公的情況

text: with working from an office.
And we used lots of comparatives.
So it's harder to concentrate at home
or it's more difficult to get your work done
zh: 或者让你更难完成工作
zh_hant: 或者讓你更難完成工作

text: in the office.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: You can test what you've learned with a worksheet,
zh: 你可以用一张练习题来检验一下自己学到的内容。
zh_hant: 你可以用一張練習題來檢驗一下自己學到的內容。

text: which you can download for free from our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 你可以从我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com免费下载。
zh_hant: 你可以從我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com免費下載。

text: And next time we'll be talking all about games.
zh: 下次我们将聊聊游戏的话题。
zh_hant: 下次我們將聊聊遊戲的話題。

text: See you then.
Goodbye.
